trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), failing health checks with an 18% error rate. Reviewing the release history showed v2.3.0 was the most recent version that was healthy in production.

2. **Rolled back**: Deployed v2.3.0 to all three production regions. Verified the service is now healthy with an error rate of 0.2% (down from 18%).

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0") describing the failure and the mitigation taken. The on-call engineer has been paged.

Note: A root-cause investigation of v2.3.1 is still outstanding — the incident is open for the on-call to investigate.
